versions.changelog:
- No changes detected in this version.
- Version number updated to 0.1.1, but file content remains unchanged.

Initial release of ui-cloner.

- Analyzes UI screenshots and generates a reusable .skill file capturing the complete product design system.
- Supports input of one or multiple screenshots; synthesizes unified tokens, components, layouts, style, and interactions.
- Auto-detects save location, preferring project-local skills directories.
- Optional visual verification workflow to compare generated design system outputs with the originals for high accuracy.
- Output is a ready-to-install skill, enabling UI reconstruction in any target tech stack.
